label: prf:level-sufficiency
title: Proof of level sufficiency
html:
Proof. Proof of level sufficiency

Proof. The Ocneanu–Jones Markov trace \mathrm{tr}_M: H_\bullet(q) \to \mathbb{C}(q) is a compatible family along the Hecke tower H_n(R, q) \hookrightarrow H_{n+1}(R, q). It satisfies the Markov property \mathrm{tr}_M \circ \iota = \mathrm{tr}_M (Jones 1987). Hypothesis k_{\max}(P, q) \le n_0 asserts that every Wedderburn block \lambda \vdash k with k > n_0 has zero projection in T_w^{\downarrow}. Under the inclusion \iota: H_{n_0}(R, q) \hookrightarrow H_{n_1}(R, q) this vanishing is preserved. The additional blocks \lambda \vdash k with n_0 < k \le n_1 accessible at the fine level contribute zero to T_w^{\uparrow} = \iota\,T_w^{\downarrow}. Thus \mathrm{tr}_M(T_w^{\uparrow}) = \mathrm{tr}_M(\iota\,T_w^{\downarrow}) = \mathrm{tr}_M(T_w^{\downarrow}) by the Markov property. Functoriality of \mathrm{tr}_M: \mathbf{Conf} \to \mathbb{C}(q) (confinement category) extends this equality to every composite of unfoldings, establishing preservation along the full confinement chain.

For a general trace-class invariant \mathcal{F} that factors through \mathrm{tr}_M, equality of traces implies equality of values: \mathcal{F}(P^{\uparrow}) = \mathcal{F}(P). \square

Converse (unfolding necessity). If k_{\max}(P, q) > n_0 — the witnessed partition content of P exceeds the coarse strand count — then no representation of T_w^{\downarrow} as an element of H_{n_0}(q) captures all tight dual blocks of the confinement SDP. Unfolding to the smallest level n_1 with k_{\max}(P, q, n_1) \le n_1 is strictly required. The unfolded trace \mathrm{tr}_M(T_w^{\uparrow}) differs from any coarse surrogate by contributions from the additional blocks. Magic shell closure and multi-operator binding configurations (\mu(S, q) \ge 2) are the principal triggers.

Corollary (default-coarse computability). Every trace-class invariant \mathcal{F} computed at the coarsest level satisfying k_{\max} \le n is exact. Default-coarse computation is not a performance heuristic. It is the content of this proposition.
